# Minutes / records PR

**Meeting or record:** <!-- e.g., 2026-08-02-weekly -->

## Publication checklist (required)

- [ ] Folder follows `meetings/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>/notes.md` (ADR 0022 convention)
- [ ] No transcript or recording content — the minutes are the record
- [ ] No meeting links, dial-ins, passcodes, or credentials
- [ ] No confidential, privileged, or client-identifying material
- [ ] Attendees, decisions, and action items (with owners) are present
- [ ] Another attendee or the committee confirmed the attendee list; the reviewer or
      approving body is identified in `notes.md`
- [ ] Statements about identifiable individuals reviewed for accuracy and neutral phrasing
- [ ] Decisions cross-linked to canonical artifacts (ADR / PR / issue) in lq-ai
- [ ] Matching row(s) added to `decisions/README.md`

## Ratification

The 7-day objection window starts when this PR merges (= posting). After merge, confirm
the Ratification block in `notes.md` shows the posting date and the window-close date.
